data_fields.name: option_once_only
data_fields.donor_constant: true by default; option hidden when the target's visit count is above zero

data_fields.name: option_fallback
data_fields.donor_constant: invisible default flag; taken only when no visible option remains

data_fields.name: container_count_start_only
data_fields.donor_constant: visit counted only on entry at the start of the container, when the flag is set

data_fields.name: turns_since_never_visited
data_fields.donor_constant: -1 when the content was never recorded

data_fields.name: fallback_turn_advance
data_fields.donor_constant: false: a fallback follows its target without advancing the turn

best_idea: A dialogue option is hidden once its target has been read or when its condition is false, it keeps the thread it was offered on so it can resume, and a fallback option is taken automatically only when no visible option remains, without advancing the turn counter.
decision_why: Keep the once-only gate keyed by content id, the resume point per option, the fallback rule and the turn counter as a derived read; leave out the named-flow map (parked threads) for a later cell; store the resume point as a small token, not a stack copy.
acceptance: A server test sets an NPC with a once-only bridge option and a fallback goodbye option; after the bridge line is read the option is absent from the next offer; with no visible option left the goodbye is taken without the turn counter moving; turns-since reads -1 before a visit and 0 in the same turn.
